crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:a4.description: Come join our team at Crest Operations! With companies located across the United States, Crest Industries is committed to bringing together the best people and the right resources to meet today’s challenges and deliver the innovations of tomorrow. With significant recent growth and company acquisitions, Crest more than ever is a catalyst for change, using a little grit and a lot of determination to drive a forward movement for our customers and our employees. Note to Candidates: This is an evergreen job posting. While we may not have an immediate opening on our team today, we are always looking for exceptional talent to join our network. By submitting your application, you will be considered for future vacancies. We actively review submissions and will reach out when a matching role becomes available! The Finance Intern will play a key role in supporting the strategic objectives of the Finance and Treasury teams by assisting with financial analysis, cash flow management, budgeting, treasury functions, and other corporate finance initiatives at Crest Corporate. This internship provides hands-on experience working with financial data, tools, and reporting systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support informed decision-making. The individual in this role will assist in analyzing financial results and operational reports, managing the corporate credit card program, and supporting cash flow forecasting. Additionally, they will contribute to the quarterly budgeting process and gain exposure to various financial planning activities. The intern will work with key financial tools such as Vena (budgeting tool), Excel, and other financial applications to ensure accuracy and efficiency in financial reporting. Beyond technical responsibilities, this role requires strong analytical skills and business acumen to interpret financial data and present insights to the Director of Finance and Crest’s executive leadership. The intern will collaborate closely with finance professionals and business unit teams to understand financial processes, develop insights into operational drivers, and contribute to initiatives that enhance financial visibility and performance. The Finance Intern must demonstrate the core values and purpose of Crest Industries: • We own doing the right thing. • We win together. • We question the status quo. • We rise to the challenge. distro-distro:lever:c19caab5-dd1e-46a2-9.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position summary The Payroll Specialist helps support our payroll function for our growing client base. This position will be responsible for all payroll-related processing activities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Provide day-to-day payroll processing support for scheduled and off-cycle payrolls. • Import or manually enter payroll changes (payroll hours, employees updates, earnings, deductions, and tax overrides etc.). • Calculate payroll and confirm accurate entry of client-provided payroll data through generating control totals for import files and through manual review. • Respond timely and accurately to all client inquiries via email, cases, and phones. • Partner with Payroll Supervisors on special projects to support clients. • Manage and support assigned book of business. Education & Experience • High school diploma or equivalent combination of experience, skills, education (including other relevant nontraditional degree programs, certifications, or job training programs) preferred. • Minimum of one year’s experience in Customer Service. • At least one year of payroll experience is preferred but not required. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and demonstrated ability to learn other applications as needed. jobgether-jobgether:lever:19a1d16e-75e3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Engineer based in Switzerland. As a Principal Engineer stepping into an Architect-level role, you will shape the future architecture of a large-scale Merchant Experience platform. You will own the technical direction of the pillar and influence engineering strategy across multiple teams. The role combines deep hands-on technical expertise with architectural leadership, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration. You will tackle complex challenges involving scalability, performance, distributed systems, integrations, and domain modeling. You will work closely with fellow architects and engineering leaders to establish consistent standards, practices, and technical guardrails. You will also champion Domain-Driven Design and help teams turn architectural vision into robust, scalable solutions. This is an opportunity to have broad technical influence in a global, collaborative, and cloud-native engineering environment. Own and share accountability for the technical direction, architecture, and solution design within the Merchant Experience pillar. Make and guide key architectural decisions, reviewing technical and design documentation to ensure alignment with broader platform strategy and engineering standards. Contribute to organization-wide engineering strategy and standards through participation in architecture-focused initiatives and councils. Support engineering teams during implementation by creating proofs of concept, clarifying architectural decisions, and resolving complex design challenges. Investigate and address architecture-related challenges across performance, scalability, integrations, distributed systems, and other critical areas. Mentor engineers and technical leaders on architecture, design techniques, coding standards, and engineering best practices, extending technical influence across multiple teams. Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to establish cohesive architecture practices, guardrails, and standards, and drive their adoption. Act as a subject-matter authority for Domain-Driven Design and architectural best practices, educating and mentoring teams to promote consistent, high-quality solutions. Requirements: 10+ years of proven software engineering experience, including experience as a Staff or Principal Engineer, Lead Developer, Software Architect, or in a comparable senior technical leadership role. Expert theoretical and practical knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD), particularly its application to microservices architectures and complex domain modeling. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, software architecture, design patterns, and distributed systems. Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and translate architectural concepts into practical solutions. Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication skills and the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams. Professional experience with AWS or another major cloud platform such as Google Cloud or Azure. Strong technical leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Nice to have: expert-level PHP experience, familiarity with PostgreSQL and MySQL, and an understanding of modern front-end technologies. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, including the practical use of LLMs and coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code quality, is a plus. jobgether-jobgether:lever:4e1979f2-3662-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer Marketing Account Manager based in United Kingdom. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, account management, digital marketing, or a related field. Strong understanding of influencer marketing campaigns, creator partnerships, engagement, conversions, and performance metrics. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Availability to work according to a Cyprus-based schedule, Sunday through Thursday, starting at 9:30 a.m. EEST. Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements when required. Ability to align professional social media profiles with client projects when necessary. Reliable internet connection and an appropriate home working environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ad26a8f2-7229-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Performance Marketing Motion Designer / Video Editor based in United Kingdom. This role is designed for a creative professional who combines strong visual storytelling with a genuine interest in performance marketing and data. You will create, edit, and animate paid social creatives designed not only to look compelling, but also to generate measurable business results. Working closely with creative and marketing teams, you will develop concepts, test variations, analyze performance, and continuously improve advertising assets. The position offers exposure to multiple digital platforms, including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, as well as a wide range of creative formats. You will use performance metrics to understand why certain creative decisions succeed and translate those insights into stronger future campaigns. The role also encourages the use of AI-powered creative tools to accelerate ideation, production, and experimentation without compromising quality. It is an opportunity to combine motion design, video editing, visual communication, and data-driven creative strategy in a fast-paced environment. Conceptualize, design, edit, and animate static and video assets for performance-focused social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms. Translate marketing objectives, audience insights, and campaign goals into engaging creative concepts designed to drive measurable actions. Break down successful advertisements into key components such as hooks, problems, solutions, proof points, offers, and calls to action, then develop modular variations for structured A/B testing. Review creative performance data and use metrics such as CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, VTR, thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and watch time to identify performance patterns. Analyze individual creative assets to determine which visual, messaging, storytelling, and editing choices contribute to stronger results. Turn campaign data and stakeholder feedback into actionable creative iterations rather than relying solely on personal design preferences. Manage complete post-production workflows, including video editing, sound design, VFX, motion graphics, dynamic typography, color correction, and creative adaptation. Adapt successful creatives into multiple versions, placements, aspect ratios, and formats while maintaining clear organization, naming conventions, and version control. Research competitor advertising, platform trends, audience behavior, and high-performing creative formats to identify new concepts and testing opportunities. Manage assigned creative projects from initial brief through final delivery while communicating effectively with creative, marketing, and account teams. Use AI-powered tools for image generation, video production, copy development, ideation, experimentation, and workflow optimization. Apply strong principles of composition, color, typography, hierarchy, pacing, and visual storytelling to create content that communicates clearly and converts effectively. Manage multiple creative projects, deadlines, and variations while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail. Requirements 3–5 years of professional experience in motion design, video editing, performance creative, or a closely related field. Strong portfolio demonstrating motion design, video editing, paid social creative, and social-first storytelling. Proven experience creating performance-oriented advertisements for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, and video engagement metrics such as watch time. Demonstrated ability to analyze creative performance and turn data-driven insights into specific, actionable recommendations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b65780ec-7866-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Regional Creative Lead based in France. As Regional Creative Lead, you will shape the creative presence of a globally recognized entertainment brand across North America, EMEA, and LATAM. You’ll combine creative leadership with hands-on production, turning strategic insights into compelling integrated campaigns. Working closely with regional marketing leads, global brand and creative teams, and agency partners, you’ll establish a consistent creative standard while adapting work to local cultures and audiences. You’ll oversee concepts from initial insight through final execution and personally create graphics, video, social, and event assets when needed. The role offers significant visibility and influence, including opportunities to present creative direction to senior leadership. Success will mean building a cohesive regional identity that feels globally recognizable while remaining culturally relevant in every market. Partner with regional marketing leads across EMEA, LATAM, and North America to ensure creative work supports regional strategies, priorities, and key moments. Lead integrated campaign concepts from initial insight and creative development through execution across multiple markets. Own the regional creative direction and quality bar, guiding internal teams and external agencies toward cohesive, high-quality, on-brand work. Translate global brand positioning into creative executions that remain consistent while adapting appropriately to local cultures, languages, and contexts. Produce high-quality creative assets across graphic design, short-form video, social content, and event materials, including work built from in-game footage. Develop creative concepts and briefs for creator agencies, balancing authentic creator expression with strong brand alignment. Present creative concepts and finished work to senior stakeholders, clearly communicating the strategic and creative rationale behind decisions. Manage multiple regions, partners, campaigns, and workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a consistently high standard of execution. Establish a clear creative identity across North America, EMEA, and LATAM and ensure it is applied consistently and effectively throughout the year. Requirements 10+ years of professional creative experience spanning design, video, social-first content, or closely related disciplines, supported by a strong and versatile portfolio. Demonstrated ability to combine creative direction with hands-on production skills and take ideas from concept through to polished final assets. Proven experience setting creative vision, raising quality standards, and directing both internal teams and multiple external agency partners. Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across global brand, creative, marketing, and external partner teams. Experience developing culturally relevant creative across multiple regions or markets, with strong judgment around what should remain globally consistent versus what should be locally adapted. Experience creating content for live events, experiential activations, social channels, and creator-led campaigns. Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate several markets, partners, and priorities without compromising quality. A strong eye for brand consistency and a practical understanding of what performs effectively across social and creator ecosystems. Experience in games, entertainment, or culturally driven consumer brands is a plus. Motion design, in-game capture, and editing skills are advantageous. Working knowledge of an additional language relevant to the regions covered by the role, such as French or Spanish, is a plus.
